title: Hot Smoked Peruvian Bamboo Shoot Suspiro Limeno
description: A sour and springy Peruvian dish featuring bamboo shoot, this suspiro limeno is a quick fix for any meal, made with binchotan charcoal for a smoky flavor and is dairy free friendly.
instructions: Start by preparing the bamboo shoots, if using canned, drain and rinse, if using fresh, peel and slice into thin strips.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, vegetable oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, smoked paprika, and salt.
Add the prepared bamboo shoots to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Prepare the binchotan charcoal by lighting it and letting it burn until it is covered in a thin layer of ash.
Once the charcoal is ready, place the marinated bamboo shoots on a heatproof plate or tray and smoke for 10 minutes.
Remove the bamboo shoots from the smoke and serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
Traditionally, suspiro limeno is served in small glasses, so consider serving the bamboo shoots in this way for a more authentic presentation.
